authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Fourteen real episodes deep, this Story's only remaining question is whether it still has a reason to keep going — and its answer, again, is simply that Gonagi and Dana are still here, still moving through a world that stopped testing them a long time ago.

scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0068.purpose: A meadow scene with nothing riding on it — the openness this Story once used to measure isolation, then relief, now measures nothing at all, which is its own kind of resolution.
scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0068.stakes: whether repetition this far into a Story still earns its place on the page
scene_spirited_away_meadow_flower_0068.opposing_force: none — by design, consistent with every recent episode

scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.purpose: A space named for transformation holds two people who finished transforming episodes ago — the irony is quiet, not pointed, and the scene doesn't need to comment on it.
scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.stakes: whether the Story's restraint (not manufacturing new stakes) is itself becoming the point

shot_spirited_00537.intent: A loose, undirected frame, no visual argument attached.

shot_spirited_00561.intent: A plain medium shot in a space whose name promises more drama than the frame delivers — deliberately.
